plan.change: Phase C follow-up: record rerun initiator in trusted verification evidence
expectedChanges: Record github.triggering_actor alongside github.actor in the trusted mechanical evidence producer metadata.
Preserve the existing exact-SHA, runId, runAttempt, workflowRef and workflowSha provenance fields.
Add a workflow contract regression test that prevents rerun-initiator provenance from being dropped.
hqDecisions: This change addresses only Work audit L1: rerun initiator provenance is absent from the trusted evidence envelope.
Keep producer.actor for the original workflow actor and add producer.triggeringActor for the actor that initiated the current run or rerun.
Do not change the evidence schema identifier, final verification state, trusted execution model, branch protection, Record v0.3, Phase D/E, or production.
plan.manualCheckExemptionReason: Trusted evidence provenance metadata change only; behavior is covered by workflow source regression, trusted PR checks, Codex review, and later rerun canary.
plan.rollback: Revert this staging-only provenance PR; production remains untouched.
outOfScope: Phase E semantic scope and concurrency controls
unverified: Post-merge rerun canary remains required before C3-1 is formally closed.
plan.problem: Trusted mechanical evidence records github.actor but not github.triggering_actor, so a rerun can be attributed only to the original run actor rather than the person or app that initiated the rerun.
plan.currentContract: The evidence producer contains actor, runId, runAttempt, workflowRef and workflowSha. GitHub exposes a separate triggering_actor value for the initiator of the current run or rerun, but the workflow does not persist it.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: For rerun auditability, runAttempt alone shows that a rerun occurred but not who initiated it. That weakens provenance when the rerun initiator differs from the original actor.
plan.design: Pass github.triggering_actor into the base-owned evidence-building step and persist it as producer.triggeringActor next to producer.actor. Keep all existing producer fields and the evidence schema identifier unchanged.
alternativesRejected: Replace actor with triggeringActor; both identities are useful and have different semantics on reruns.
Infer rerun initiator later from GitHub UI or API; the evidence envelope should carry the provenance needed to interpret the captured run.
Expand this change into authenticated human attestation; that belongs to the later Phase C work.
plan.compatibility: Existing evidence consumers that ignore unknown producer fields remain compatible; existing producer.actor semantics are unchanged.
boundaryCases: A normal first run may have actor and triggeringActor equal.
A rerun initiated by another authorized actor can have triggeringActor differ from actor and both must be retained.
runAttempt continues to identify the attempt associated with triggeringActor.
The evidence remains UNVERIFIED and exact-SHA-bound.
testPlan: Assert change-verification.yml maps github.triggering_actor into an environment variable for the evidence step.
Assert the evidence producer contains triggeringActor sourced from that environment variable.
Run Change Operations Tests, Change PR Gate and Change Verification Evidence on the exact PR head.
Request Codex adversarial review focused on L1 provenance.
After merge, exercise a rerun canary and inspect evidence provenance before formal C3-1 closure.
plan.promotionRisk: Staging Change OS workflow only. Missing or misbound rerun identity would weaken audit evidence, so trusted checks and later rerun canary are required.
